title: RAG platform
description: A question is checked, answered from the company's own documents, and checked again on the way out. Dashed components keep the knowledge base fresh and the platform observable.

detail.role: Ask questions in natural language through a chat UI or an API.
detail.why: The source of all request traffic.

detail.role: Authenticates the caller and enforces per-team rate limits.
detail.why: One front door where identity and quotas are applied before any model spend.

security.text: Every call carries an identity, so retrieval can be filtered by what that person may read.

cost.text: A runaway client hits its own limit instead of the shared budget.

detail.role: Rewrites the question, retrieves passages, builds the prompt and returns the answer with citations.
detail.why: Keeps retrieval and prompting logic in one place so it can be tested and versioned.

cost.text: Every passage added to the prompt is billed as input tokens, so top-k and passage length are cost settings.

risks.text: Too few passages miss the answer, too many dilute it and raise cost. Tune it against the evaluation set.

detail.role: Screens the prompt and the answer for personal data, prompt injection and off-topic content.
detail.why: Checks sit outside the model, so they hold whichever model is behind them.

security.text: Personal data is masked before it leaves for the model provider and again before it reaches the user.

risks.text: A poisoned document can carry instructions. Screening reduces this but cannot remove it, so tool access stays off here.

detail.role: Writes the answer from the question and the retrieved passages.
detail.why: A hosted model avoids running GPUs for a workload that is spiky.

security.text: The contract excludes customer data from training. Traffic leaves over a private endpoint.

cost.text: Billed per input and output token. Most of the monthly bill is here.

risks.text: An outage or a deprecated model stops every answer. See the LLM gateway example for failover.

detail.role: Returns a stored answer when a new question means the same as an earlier one.
detail.why: Many staff ask the same things, and a hit costs almost nothing.

cost.text: A hit avoids retrieval and generation entirely.

security.text: An answer is only reused for callers who may read the same documents.

risks.text: A cached answer can outlive the document it came from. Entries expire when their source is re-indexed.

detail.role: Finds the passages closest in meaning to the question, filtered by the caller's access.
detail.why: Meaning-based search finds answers that share no keywords with the question.

security.text: Each chunk keeps the permissions of its source document, applied as a filter at query time.

risks.text: Filters are enforced inside the store, not in the service, so a bug upstream cannot widen access.

detail.role: Records each request's prompt, passages, answer, tokens and latency, and scores samples against a reference set.
detail.why: Answer quality drifts silently, so it is measured the same way latency is.

cost.text: Spend is attributed to a team and a use case, which makes the bill explainable.

security.text: Traces hold user questions, so they are redacted and kept for 30 days only.

detail.role: Where the company's knowledge lives today.
detail.why: The platform reads from these and never becomes a second copy to maintain by hand.

detail.role: Splits documents into chunks, computes embeddings and writes them with their permissions.
detail.why: Answers are only as current as the last run, so it runs on change, not on a timetable.

cost.text: A content hash skips unchanged documents, so a re-index does not pay for the whole corpus again.

risks.text: If a document is locked down in the source, its chunks stay readable until the next sync. Sync runs every 15 minutes.

links.label: Question
links.detail: A question arrives over HTTPS and the answer streams back on the same connection.

links.label: Authenticated call
links.detail: The gateway forwards the request with the caller's identity and team.

links.label: Prompt check
links.detail: The assembled prompt is screened before it goes out, and the answer is screened on its way back.

links.label: Generate
links.detail: The cleaned prompt goes to the model provider over a private endpoint, and the answer returns.

links.label: Retrieve
links.detail: The service sends the question's embedding and the caller's access groups, and gets back the closest passages.

links.label: Look up
links.detail: Before retrieving, the service asks whether an equivalent question was answered recently.

links.label: Trace
links.detail: Each request emits a trace record. It is sent after the answer, so it adds no latency.

links.label: Changes
links.detail: A created or edited document notifies the pipeline, which fetches it.

links.label: Writes chunks
links.detail: Chunks, embeddings and permissions are written in batches. Nothing on the request path waits for this.

trace.label: A staff member asks a question
The gateway checks identity and the team's quota
The service first asks whether this was answered before
The cache has no equivalent answer yet
A miss, so the service searches the knowledge base
The closest passages the caller may read are returned
The prompt is assembled with those passages
Personal data and injection attempts are screened out
The model writes a cited answer
